speaker: counselor
text: What would you like to talk about today?

speaker: student
text: Honestly, school is okay. What is hard is that I used to pray five times a day with my community, and here I do it in the library stairwell.

speaker: student
text: Like I have to hide a part of me. There is no prayer room on campus that I know of, and Fridays I miss the congregational prayer because of my lab.

speaker: counselor
text: Have you asked about a prayer room?

speaker: student
text: No, I did not know if I was allowed to ask.

speaker: student
text: I have three exams in one week and I keep starting to study too late. I plan to start at six and then it is midnight.

speaker: student
text: It was easier at home, my mother kept the schedule for the house.
